selection_rule: All four already inspected development tasks and the existing eighth-response boundary. Posthoc baseline-strengthening comparison, not a heldout effectiveness test. No task replacement or extra trial after outcomes.
order_rule: Plain then notification on task indices 1 and 3; notification then plain on 2 and 4. One trial per cell. Review all eight cells before describing benefit.
notification_rule: Only budget_keep receives a fresh ephemeral user message before each model call: remaining and used API/model/token budgets, remaining wall-time snapshot, context and per-output limits. No future-cost prediction or task-specific hints. The full underlying conversation and persistent Python state are identical at the boundary. Notifications are charged and never accumulated in the underlying history.
cache_rule: Both conditions use cache_prompt=false for their first continuation call and confirm cache_n=0 from terminal measurement. Subsequent calls use true. This prevents reuse of the preceding condition's prefix, not all sources of nondeterminism. Historical P33/P38 timings are not direct controls.
budget_rule: Original API caps include the prefix. Same 16 calls, 120000 full logical input+output tokens, and 480 continuation seconds. Notification construction and counting time belong to continuation. Reconstructing the common prefix is separately recorded. No extra model calls for control or verification.
failure_rule: Setup mismatch, unknown model usage/effects, cache-policy mismatch, evaluator failure, or an explicit stop ends the batch without a replacement. Ordinary budget or task failures are retained and the fixed next cell runs if the same server is idle and its lease suffices.
continuation_gate: This is a familiar budget-awareness baseline. A favorable result is not novel or a general quality guarantee. Check paired task outcomes, all-cost totals, incomplete trials, notification overhead, and source/counter correspondence before using it as a comparator for a new mechanism.
